status.description: Reads the answer. Every other status arrives as an error body carrying recovery.

name.description: Calls the thing this in English. Absent on a page read with `after`.

key.description: Names the key in the Brief and sends it as a `shopping_search` spec key.

display_name.description: Calls the key this when it writes it down or says it out loud.

type.description: Types the value the agent sends and reads for this key.

unit.description: States the value in this unit, the one sil holds it in.

allowed_values.description: Maps the buyer's word into the closed set; an enum without one takes any name, a maker's for `brand`.

operators.description: Picks the comparison that fits: `eq`/`in` on a variant spec and on enums, `gte`/`lte` on numbers and money.

description.description: Reads how this one key moves the fit — what it decides, what goes wrong at either end of it, and how a buyer's own fact becomes a value for it. Reason from it; ask from it; never recite it back. Only on a `keys` read.

step.description: Asks on the grid the maker prints the axis in — 0.5 for a Mondopoint size. A figure off the grid is something sil has not read as a value. Only on a `keys` read.

product_spec.description: Never treats two products that differ on it as one.

several.description: Reads a list for it: a product holds several at once.

ordered.description: `allowed_values` run in order, least first: `gte`/`lte` take one and reach every one past it — "filter or coarser" is `gte filter`, never `eq filter`.

specs.description: Builds spec rows with keys sil holds: index lines in the place’s own order, own keys first, as many as one answer holds; or only the `keys` asked, whole.

next.description: Sends it as `after` to read the index on: the first key not listed. Absent on the last page, so nothing is cut unseen.

keys_total.description: Counts the keys of the whole index, over its pages.

key.description: Names the key in the Brief and sends it as a `shopping_search` spec key.

display_name.description: Calls the key this when it writes it down or says it out loud.

type.description: Types the value the agent sends and reads for this key.

unit.description: States the value in this unit, the one sil holds it in.

allowed_values.description: Maps the buyer's word into the closed set; an enum without one takes any name, a maker's for `brand`.

operators.description: Picks the comparison that fits: `eq`/`in` on a variant spec and on enums, `gte`/`lte` on numbers and money.

description.description: Reads how this one key moves the fit — what it decides, what goes wrong at either end of it, and how a buyer's own fact becomes a value for it. Reason from it; ask from it; never recite it back. Only on a `keys` read.

step.description: Asks on the grid the maker prints the axis in — 0.5 for a Mondopoint size. A figure off the grid is something sil has not read as a value. Only on a `keys` read.

seller_specs.description: Builds seller rows for `shopping_offers`; with `keys`, only those asked. First page only.

labels.description: Reads every other word for the thing; never sends them. Absent with `keys` and after the first page.

from.description: Reads the node that declares these keys.

via.description: Reads how: its own, a kind it is, a part’s link, or a leaf under a kind.

part.description: Names the part, where `via` is one.

keys.description: Reads the keys, in the node’s order.

reach.description: Reads where each key comes from. Absent with `keys` and after the first page.

path.description: Reads the kind on its own node.

kinds.description: Reads every kind this thing is, nearest first. Absent with `keys` and after the first page.

role.description: Reads the node any thing that fills this part is.

elsewhere.description: Reads the part in plain words, where no node draws it yet.

how.description: Knows whether the part is built in, in the box, bought apart or used with it.

optional.description: Knows whether some of these things come without it.

many.description: Knows whether the thing has several of the part.

keys.description: Reads the keys the link says about the part, here.

parts.description: Reads what the thing has. Absent with `keys` and after the first page.

path.description: Reads the node this part or consumable is made for.

elsewhere.description: Reads what it is made for in plain words, where no node draws it yet.

made_for.description: Reads what a part is made for. Absent with `keys` and after the first page.

leaves.description: On a kind: every leaf under it. A search on the kind answers across them, `leaf` a key it takes. Absent with `keys` and after the first page.

record.description: On a leaf: bought on its measures alone, or on its measures and its record. Absent with `keys` and after the first page.
